summary: Full backend + frontend testing of PrioMail referral and coupon systems, plus the new logo & coupon input on Pricing. 23/23 pytest backend tests pass; all UI flows (header logo, pricing coupon apply/clear/discount, admin overview stats, admin referrals create/copy/toggle/delete, admin coupons create/copy/toggle/delete, /r/{code} redirect with click event + localStorage) verified end-to-end. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: stats query for events does a per-referral query inside the list loop (N+1). Acceptable for current scale but worth refactoring with aggregation if list grows >100s.
Admin routes are intentionally unauthenticated for now — must be gated behind auth before production.
Pricing.jsx: applyDiscount rounds with Math.round and floors at 0 — correct. CTA URL correctly carries coupon param to register flow.
ReferralRedirect.jsx: gracefully handles invalid codes by routing to '/' after 1.5s.

All required data-testids (header-logo-mark, coupon-form/input/apply/applied/clear, pricing-pro-price/original, new-referral-btn, referral-create-form, submit-create-referral, referral-row-{CODE}, copy-link-{CODE}, toggle-{CODE}, delete-{CODE}, new-coupon-btn, coupon-create-form, submit-create-coupon, coupon-row-{CODE}, copy-coupon-{CODE}, toggle-coupon-{CODE}, delete-coupon-{CODE}) are present and functional.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own TEST_/UI* prefixed data and clean up via API at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_referrals_coupons.py — covers status, all referral CRUD + events + stats (percent & fixed reward math), all coupon CRUD + validate (valid/not-found/inactive/expired/max-uses) + redeem + redemptions + admin/stats. UI verified with Playwright: header logo image src=/priomail-icon-white.svg renders; Pricing coupon form applies a real coupon (UITEST20 percent=20 -> ₹249 became ₹199 with strikethrough), CTA URL gets ?coupon= param, clear restores price; admin overview shows 8 stat cards (stat-card-total-codes, stat-card-clicks, stat-card-sign-ups, stat-card-conversions, stat-card-total-coupons, stat-card-redemptions, stat-card-total-revenue, stat-card-conversion-rate); admin referrals form uses testids input-owner-name/input-owner-email/input-custom-code/select-reward-type/input-reward-value/input-notes (NOT name attributes); admin coupons form uses input-coupon-code/input-coupon-description/select-discount-type/input-discount-value/input-max-uses/input-valid-until; /r/UIREDIR1 successfully fired 2 click events on backend and set localStorage.priomail_ref=UIREDIR1 and redirected to /?ref=UIREDIR1. Toast confirmation 'Referral deleted' appears after delete.
